dish: The 1885 Menches family hamburger (ground beef mixed with brown sugar and coffee) — 50 burgers on the menu
w: The Menches family claims the invention of the hamburger (Erie County Fair, 1885) and the ice-cream cone; the family opened this Green restaurant in 1994 and still uses the 1885 recipe. Covered by WKSU/Ideastream Quick Bites, Akron Life Burger Week and News 5 (the family's original hamburger and cone presses).

dish: The half-pound Hodge Burger (cheese, onion, garlic pickles) with fresh-cut fries
w: Barberton tavern since 1975 (Bill 'Hodge' Hodgkinson; now run by his daughter). Roadfood calls its hand-formed half-pound burgers a standard of hamburger excellence; the Akron Beacon Journal's National Cheeseburger Day picks note it has been voted Best Burger in Barberton for 30 years running.

dish: Made-to-order breakfast and brunch with McConnell eggs, Holiday Italian sausage and house baked goods
w: Bright Green-township brunch café. One of the Akron Beacon Journal's '8 restaurants we recommend when asked where should I eat in Akron' and profiled by Akron Life ('Get next-level breakfast and brunch at Sunrise Social').

dish: Broasted chicken, real mashed potatoes and the Brown Bag Apple Pie from the from-scratch bakery
w: Opened 1977 as a 48-seat restaurant and grown into a village with a bakery (watch the bakers through a window), inn and market — Stark County's gateway to Amish Country. Featured in Ohio Magazine's Amish Country food guides and by Visit Canton.

dish: Adjarian khachapuri, shawarma and falafel — Armenian and Georgian home cooking
w: Opened 2022 by an Armenian family who came to Canton from Georgia in 2005 — the only Armenian/Georgian kitchen in the region. Picked in Akron Life's '6 newer spots to eat in Canton' and Visit Canton's international-cuisine guide.

dish: Dry-rubbed 'sauceless' wings and tenders with a rotating list of Ohio craft beer
w: Woman-owned Northeast Ohio chicken-and-beer shop (Berea 2018); its largest location opened on the Front Street DORA in January 2024. Cleveland Scene covered the opening, the Akron Beacon Journal reviewed it among downtown Cuyahoga Falls' newest restaurants, and Cleveland Magazine lists it in the city's best restaurants and bars.

dish: The Cancun Pineapple — a hollowed pineapple filled with shrimp, scallops, steak and chicken
w: Stow Mexican restaurant. An Akron Beacon Journal Local Flavor pick (twice, incl. its 2025 'restaurants Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce should try' list) and Akron Life Best of the City 2024 readers' pick for Best Patio Dining.

dish: Pan-seared scallops on butternut-squash risotto, tomato bisque, Wagyu meatloaf and smoked brisket
w: Kent bistro on West Main at the Stow line, run by brothers Aaron (chef) and Jason Ruggles. Reviewed by Akron Life ('A Good Bistro on Main') and recommended by the Akron Beacon Journal's Local Flavor team in 2025.

dish: Homestyle breakfast plates and comfort-food dinners
w: Stow family restaurant voted Best Breakfast (#1) in Akron Life's Best of the City 2025 readers' picks and reviewed by the Akron Beacon Journal ('Tip Top Restaurant in Stow offers tip-top homestyle meals').

dish: Pulled pork and chicken in his late father's sweet-and-spicy sauce, with Dad's baked mac 'n' cheese
w: Opened 2016 by culinary-school grad Eugene Wilson and named for his father. Voted Best Barbecue (#1) in Akron Life's Best of the City 2025, profiled in Akron Life ('Family Style') and by WKYC.

dish: House-roasted espresso drinks and cold brew
w: Akron roaster-café since 2006 (spun off from Coco's Cafe), with a moody bar-like room on West Market. Signal Akron Best of the City coffee/tea winner and Akron Life Best of the City 2025 Best Coffeehouse (#1).
